changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0053. Store the planned length of a membership freeze so the end date can move when the freeze is booked. Index review: no new index; UX_MembershipFreezes_Open and IX_MembershipFreezes_GymMembershipId already seek one membership. Performance note: the column is read with the freeze row.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MembershipFreezes ADD PlannedDays INT NULL;
ALTER TABLE app.MembershipFreezes ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipFreezes_PlannedDays CHECK (PlannedDays IS NULL OR PlannedDays > 0);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MembershipFreezes DROP CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipFreezes_PlannedDays; ALTER TABLE app.MembershipFreezes DROP COLUMN PlannedDays;
